 1 | Boil Liquid | 1 cu'/lvl | C | 10' | F

 3 | Woodfires | 1'R | - | self | F

 5 | Heat Solid | 1 cu'/lvl | 1 min/lvl (C) | 10' | F
 6 | Fire Bolt I | 1 target | - | 100' | DE
 7 | Call Flame I | 10'x10'x10' | 1 rnd/lvl | 10' | E
 8 | Fire Ball | 10'R | - | 100' | BE
 9 | Ignite | 5'R/lvl | P | 5'/lvl | E
10 | Circle Aflame | 10'R | 1 rnd/lvl | self | E

14 | Firestorm | 10'x10'x10' | 1 rnd/lvl | 20' | E
15 | Metal Fires | 1 lb/lvl | 1 rnd/lvl | 100' | F
16 | Triad of Flame | 3 targets | - | 100' | DE
17 | Fire Bolt V | 1 target | - | 500' | DE
18 | Waiting Firestorm | 10'x10'x10' | varies | 20' | E
19 | Call Flame V | 50'x50'x50' | 1 rnd/lvl | 50' | E
20 | Corner Fires | 1 target | - | 300' | DE
25 | Following Fires | 1 target | - | 300' | DE
30 | Stone Fires | 300 sq' | 1 rnd/lvl | 100' | F
50 | Fire Mastery | varies | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
For each level of caster, one cubic foot of liquid can be heated to boiling at
a rate of 1 cubic foot per round.
@@ 2
Any solid inanimate, non-metal material (up to 1 cubic foot per level) can be
warmed to 100ºF at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration.
@@ 3
Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be within 1' of
caster’s palm.
@@ 4
Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through
it takes an 'A' Heat critical (no RR).
@@ 5
As Warm Solid, except for duration and material can be heated to 500ºF at a
rate of 50ºF per round. The caster must concentrate to increase the
temperature (without concentration, the material will remain at its current
temperature for the duration of the spell).
@@ 6
A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire
Bolt Attack Table 13.5 (p. 84).
@@ 7
As Wall of Fire, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10').
The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing
through or that is caught inside the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical each
round he is inside.
@@ 8
A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching
its target, it explodes to affect a 10' radius area. Resolve the attack on the
Fire Ball Attack Table 13.4 (p. 83).
@@ 9
The caster may designate a type of burning light source to ignite or
extinguish (e.g., candles, torches, fireplaces, lanterns, etc.). This spell
will affect all of the light sources of the specified type(s) within the area
of effect.
@@ 10
As Wall of Fire, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10' radius circle (6''
thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).
@@ 11
As Fire Bolt I, except range is 300'.
@@ 12
As Call Flame I, except cube is up to 20'x20'x20' in size and the range is
20'.
@@ 13
As Call Flame I, except the effect can be delayed for up to 24 hours. The
effect can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time
of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent
actions in the area, etc.
@@ 14
As Call Flame, except small balls of flame rain down in a 10' cube causing a
'B' Heat critical to all passing through (or caught within).
@@ 15
Causes a metal object to burst into flames. The object can be up to 1 lb per
level in mass. If the object is on a being, it gets a RR. If the RR fails, the
being takes an automatic Heat critical of a severity to be determined by its
location on the being’s body. If the object is touching exposed flesh, the
being takes a 'C' Heat critical; if the object is touching through cloth, the
being takes a 'B' Heat critical; in all other cases, the being takes an 'A'
Heat critical.
@@ 16
Three bolts of fire are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up
to three different targets (as long as they are all withing 60º of each other;
and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill
(Firebolt) to only one of the attacks (others get a +0 OB).
@@ 17
As Fire Bolt I, except the range is 500'.
@@ 18
As Waiting Flame, except a Firestorm can be delayed.
@@ 19
As Call Flame I, except size is up to a 50' cube and the range is 50'.
@@ 20
As Fire Bolt III, except caster can make the bolt turn once up to 90º before
striking the target (the caster must know the target’s location). The OB for
the bolt is halved after making the turn.
@@ 25
As Corner Fires, except bolt can make as many turns as necessary and go
through openings (must be larger than 6'' radius) to strike the target.
@@ 30
As Metal Fires, except up to a 300 square foot stone surface is affected and a
'C' Heat critical is given each round passing through (or caught within) the
3' flames.
@@ 50
Caster can use any one lower level spell (on this list) each round.
